documents.title: Generative AI at VCU
documents.quality_note: Mostly data and tool rules, with a section stating instructors give students guidance on AI use and FERPA limits on uploading student work.

notes: The Nov 12 2025 'Acceptable Use of Generative AI Technology' policy full text was not located on policy.vcu.edu; only summaries (blogs.vcu.edu/ai post, ICO blog) were found and not collected as they are news/explainers. VCU Honor System page (conduct.students.vcu.edu) has no AI text. School of Medicine AI policy (assets.som.vcu.edu) exists but is outside computing and not collected. No CS department or Engineering AI policy found. Known URLs were course syllabi (deferred).
